title: Spectral properties of the resistance Laplacian with applications to data clustering and anomaly detection
summary: The resistance Laplacian is a graph matrix associated with the effective resistance metric and provides a global counterpart of the classical graph Laplacian. Although it inherits several fundamental properties of the ordinary Laplacian, including a connected graph partitioning theorem analogous to that of Fiedler, its intrinsic spectral structure has remained largely unexplored. In this paper, we develop a structural theory of the resistance Laplacian.
